swap_array.parameters: int *p, int n, int i, int j
swap_array.contract: /*@ With (l: list Z) Require 0 <= i && i < n && 0 <= j && j < n && i != j && IntArray::full(p,n,l) Ensure IntArray::full(p,n,replace_Znth(j,Znth(i,l,0),replace_Znth(i,Znth(j,l,0),l))) */

pairs.scope_note: Comparison concerns each language contract at this target. It is not a claim of arbitrary whole-file contract equivalence.
pairs.manual_derivation: Save old l[i], write old l[j] to i, then saved old l[i] to j; i!=j. This equals the nested replace_Znth post.
